intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
GITAM Visakhapatnam vs IIM Visakhapatnam is not a single winner. GITAM Visakhapatnam holds NIRF 2025 #101 on our records, and IIM Visakhapatnam holds NIRF 2025 #29.

sections.heading: GITAM Visakhapatnam vs IIM Visakhapatnam for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose GITAM Visakhapatnam if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #101, and a 2020 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Visakhapatnam.
Choose IIM Visakhapatnam if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #29, and a 2024 flagship package record of ₹16 LPA, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Visakhapatnam.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹1.8 lakh as a tuition figure for MBA in Hospital and Healthcare Management at GITAM Visakhapatnam. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹8.91 lakh as a programme total for Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM) at IIM Visakhapatnam.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: GITAM Visakhapatnam's latest recorded flagship year here is 2020, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹9 LPA on MBA Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

IIM Visakhapatnam's latest recorded flagship year here is 2024, with an average of ₹16 LPA and a highest package of ₹43 LPA on Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2020 and 2024, so the packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: GITAM Visakhapatnam is listed on our records with CAT, NMAT, XAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
IIM Visakhapatnam is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Andhra Pradesh. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
GITAM Visakhapatnam is listed as a private institute and IIM Visakhapatnam as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether GITAM Visakhapatnam's recorded ₹1.8 lakh or IIM Visakhapatnam's ₹8.91 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If ranks and the wider recruiter mix matter most, IIM Visakhapatnam is the stronger recorded option on this page, with NIRF 2025 #29 against NIRF 2025 #101.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, GITAM Visakhapatnam or IIM Visakhapatnam?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. GITAM Visakhapatnam and IIM Visakhapatnam differ in more than one way: GITAM Visakhapatnam holds NIRF 2025 #101 on our records, while IIM Visakhapatnam holds NIRF 2025 #29, and one is listed as private and the other as public.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for GITAM Visakhapatnam vs IIM Visakhapatnam?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹1.8 lakh for GITAM Visakhapatnam on MBA in Hospital and Healthcare Management; our records list ₹8.91 lakh for IIM Visakhapatnam on Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM). Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for GITAM Visakhapatnam and IIM Visakhapatnam?
faqs.answer: GITAM Visakhapatnam's latest recorded flagship year here is 2020, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹9 LPA on MBA Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do GITAM Visakhapatnam and IIM Visakhapatnam accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT, NMAT, XAT for GITAM Visakhapatnam, and CAT for IIM Visakhapatnam. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are GITAM Visakhapatnam and IIM Visakhapatnam in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
